powerlaw.note: log10(價)＝a＋b·log10(距 2009-01-03 天數)，每天只用當天以前的 CoinMetrics 價格擬合（無前視）；頂部推估＝最近一次頂部倍數 ÷ 過去每輪縮小倍數（最大～最小），乘 2029-10-01 合理價；樣本只有 4 輪，僅作長期路徑交叉驗證，不連動倉位

framework.name: Daybreak 出場框架 v2
framework.unit: 以「100% ＝ 本週期打算賣出的全部持倉」計，不涉及任何人的實際持倉
framework.unit_en: Measured as "100% = everything you plan to sell this cycle"; no one's actual holdings are involved

hedge.rule: 收盤連 5 日在 200 日均線之下 → 減 20%；連 5 日收回或 MVRV Z 7 日均 < 0.5 → 補回
hedge.rule_en: Close below the 200-day MA for 5 straight days → cut 20%; buy back after 5 straight closes above it, or when the MVRV Z 7-day average < 0.5

onchain.rule: MVRV ÷ 前一輪高點連 5 日 ≥ 0.75 → 賣一階
onchain.rule_en: MVRV ÷ prior-cycle peak ≥ 0.75 for 5 straight days → sell one step

onchain.rule: 連 5 日 ≥ 0.80 → 再賣一階
onchain.rule_en: ≥ 0.80 for 5 straight days → sell one more step

onchain.rule: 前兩條觸發過後，每次收盤創新高但 MVRV ≤ 一年最高的 0.9 倍 → 賣一階
onchain.rule_en: After both have fired: each new closing high with MVRV ≤ 0.9× its 1-year high → sell one step

framework.accelerate: 頂部三指標（MVRV Z／NUPL／Puell 四年百分位）任兩項 ≥ 80 → 進入頂部區；≥ 85 連 5 日 → 多賣兩階；≥ 90 → 10 個交易日內賣完
framework.accelerate_en: Top three indicators (MVRV Z / NUPL / Puell, 4-year percentiles): any two ≥ 80 → top zone; ≥ 85 for 5 days → sell two extra steps; ≥ 90 → sell everything within 10 trading days
framework.time_stop: 2029/10–2030/03 剩餘部位每月等量賣完
framework.time_stop_en: 2029/10–2030/03: sell the remainder in equal monthly amounts
